atomic_facts.fact: Do Kwon was arrested in Montenegro.
The arrest was carried out by Montenegrin authorities.
Do Kwon was extradited from Montenegro to the United States.
Do Kwon was not extradited to South Korea.
France24 reports Do Kwon was extradited from Montenegro to the United States.
BBC reports Do Kwon was to be extradited from Montenegro to the United States.
Reuters reports Montenegro extradited Do Kwon to the United States.
The cited excerpts contain no report of an extradition to South Korea; all identify the United States as the destination.
